name: How long does it take to install custom mudroom storage?
description: Installation time for custom mudroom storage varies but typically involves a design phase, fabrication, and 3-7 days for on-site installation.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install custom mudroom storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for installing custom mudroom storage varies depending on the complexity of the design, the materials chosen, and the scope of work involved. Typically, the design phase can take a few weeks, followed by fabrication, and then on-site installation which usually ranges from 3-7 days. During the initial consultation, Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project schedule, outlining key milestones from design approval to final installation, ensuring clarity on the process duration.
